Natural anatomy, distinct and meaningful therapist hand placement, plain slip-on shoes, no branded equipment. Pure white isolation. Pure white background, show every subject and essential prop whole inside the middle two thirds of the canvas. IMPORTANT: zoom the composition OUT. Leave roughly ONE SIXTH of canvas width on both the left and right and generous WHITE space above and below. No object or person's extremity touches an edge. No border. Absolutely no text, lettering, digits, writing or pseudo-writing, labels, watermarks, brand marks, logos or emblems anywhere. One clear composition.
